generations.name: Launch (2021)
generations.notes: Launch. Standard Range 75.7 kWh gross / 68 kWh usable (DC up to 115 kW Select, 150 kW Premium); Extended Range 98.8 kWh gross / 88 kWh usable (DC up to 150 kW). Split because the 2022 usable-capacity unlock changes the usable kWh and so the charging curve. Wikipedia lists 2021-22 together; the InsideEVs 2022 article and Ford's 2022 order guide (as reported) give the 88 to 91 kWh change. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ford_Mustang_Mach-E ; https://insideevs.com/news/555287/2022-ford-mache-more-range/

generations.name: Usable-capacity unlock (2022)
generations.notes: Same NCM packs with more usable energy: SR 70 kWh usable, ER 91 kWh usable. MY2023 is mixed: InsideEVs lists LFP 72 kWh Standard Range cars as 2023 models (https://insideevs.com/news/666041/lfp-2023-ford-mustang-mache-compared/), while early 2023 SR cars are 70 kWh NCM. Late-2023 SR cars may belong to the next entry. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/555287/2022-ford-mache-more-range/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/722612/2024-ford-mustang-mache-epa-range/

generations.name: LFP Standard Range
generations.notes: All Standard Range cars switch to a CATL LFP pack, 72 kWh usable, DC peak up from 115 kW to 150 kW and 10-80% from 38 to 33 min. Extended Range stays 91 kWh usable NCM. first_year could reasonably be 2023 (LFP started during MY2023). The ER pack did not change, so ER curves carry over from 2022. No CA-specific pack differences found. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/666041/lfp-2023-ford-mustang-mache-compared/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/722612/2024-ford-mustang-mache-epa-range/
